name: team_planning_undo_step
description: Get what the caller's Undo and Redo would act on in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: undo is their own latest change, pin, clear or move there that can still be undone, and redo the change their latest undo took back that can still be redone, each as team_planning_undo_change and team_planning_redo_change pick one with no event_id. Each is { event_id, action, subject_id, subject, facet, scenario_id } or null: action is set, clear, move or dates, subject the name of a person or unit (null for anything else), and a dates entry has no subject or facet and names the step whose dates it set in scenario_id. Neither ever names a value. A pay change, or one on a budget line that carries an amount, is offered only to a member with the see-pay right; anyone else is offered their latest other change, or null. Both are null for a viewer, for the baseline, and for an archived or frozen plan, and when the change is about someone or something outside the units a scoped plan covers, or when it brings back a unit of a type removed since. An undo of a clear that brings someone back into those units is offered with subject null, since the plan covers them only once it lands. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
